title: First scheduler day (4/03): a check skipped re-prediction when the picked team's lineup posted after its opponent's
missing_evidence: Pi5 scheduler output for 2026-04-03 (journal or redirected stderr; Pi5 decommissioned 4/14, retention unknown) showing a check returned 'skipped' with 0 new confirmations after the picked team's lineup posted — Phase 2 Route R
the 2026-04-03 scheduler state (runs_completed skipped flags) and pick file (lock/post time vs game time) in B1, if retained
tier_reason: if it fired, the pick was locked or fallback-posted without re-predicting on the picked team's confirmed lineup; no effect on the 4/03 delivery is evidenced

contract.text: When new lineups are confirmed, the scheduler re-runs predictions and re-evaluates the lock before any post.

mechanism.text: check_confirmed_lineups marked a game confirmed as soon as either side's batting order appeared and count_new_confirmations tracked game_pks, so the picked team's later lineup produced no new confirmation
run_single_check returned skipped (no predictions, no lock evaluation) whenever count_new_confirmations was 0

watchdog.trigger: a pick is committed while the prediction run it came from predates a lineup confirmation for the picked team's game
watchdog.recovery_assertion: every committed pick comes from a prediction run after the last lineup confirmation for its game that preceded the commit

evidence.what: the skip-if-no-new-confirmations gate 'had a bug: a game marked confirmed because the opposing team posted a lineup would not re-trigger when the picked team's lineup posted later'; the gate was removed so every check runs the cascade
game-level confirmation (either side) plus an early return when no game was newly confirmed

evidence.locator: git history: 5f73a59 and 5d9b803 (4/03 01:01–01:13 ET) added the user-level systemd scheduler unit
evidence.what: the scheduler daemon went live on 4/03, the day of the fix
